title: OCR Hinders RAG: Evaluating the Cascading Impact of OCR on Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical impact of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) noise on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. It evaluates performance metrics like retrieval accuracy and generation quality across several domains, but does not benchmark or analyze religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
